
SHOW-ACCEPTANCE-CRITERIA
Display acceptance criteria (scenarios) for a feature file

USAGE
  fspec show-acceptance-criteria <file>

ARGUMENTS
  <file> (required)
    Feature file path

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Show acceptance criteria
  $ fspec show-acceptance-criteria spec/features/login.feature
  Feature: User Login

Scenario: Login with valid credentials
  Given I am on the login page
  When I enter valid credentials
  Then I should be logged in

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec get-scenarios
  fspec show-feature
